'''Kris Earle Boxborough 2-17-2001 Director's Report (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Kris Earle]] posted on DeckTech on 19 February 2001 about [[February 2001 Boxboro tournament (constructed)]].<ref name="tr-d1750">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-19-boxborough-2-17-2001-directors-reportd1750/ boxborough-2-17-2001-directors-report], DeckTech (Kris "Figgiedan" Earle, 19 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-19-boxborough-2-17-2001-directors-reportd1750/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Tournament director Kris Earle reported that 14 players took part in the Jabba's Palace sealed event and 32 in the constructed event at Boxborough, Massachusetts, on 17 February 2001.

== Report info ==
* '''Author:''' [[Kris Earle]] (byline: Kris "Figgiedan" Earle)
* '''Published:''' 19 February 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Report title:''' ''Boxborough 2-17-2001 Director's Report''
* '''Event:''' [[February 2001 Boxboro tournament (constructed)]]
* '''Event date:''' 17 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Boxborough, MA
* '''Players:''' 32

== Side event: February 2001 Boxboro tournament (Jabba's Palace sealed) ==

The report also covers [[February 2001 Boxboro tournament (Jabba's Palace sealed)]] (17 February 2001). 14 players took part in the Jabba's Palace sealed event.

== Original report ==

'''boxborough-2-17-2001-directors-report'''
* '''Author:''' Kris "Figgiedan" Earle
* '''Published:''' Feb 19, 2001

<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
  Quick 1st try ---- 14 people showed for Jabba’s sealed.

32 people for the Constructed.

Will post the winners and edit later tomorrow...

can I do that after submitting? We shall see.





-Figgiedan, RED 110
</nowiki></div>
